snippet.title: Factorio - Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
The official Factorio trailer for 2026

Homepage (free demo / buy the game): http://www.factorio.com.
Steampage: http://store.steampowered.com/app/427520/

Video: The Factorio team.
Music & Sound: Daniel James Taylor.

This trailer is based on a real game of about 12 hours. The map has been extended and polished in the in-game map editor. All the actions, movement and logic in general in the trailer are controlled by the game native modding system (Lua scripting).

This trailer is the third and final improved version of the original 2014 trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9yDZM0diiYc
